# hecate.demo

A small demonstration package: counters and a suspending wait.

## Syntax

```lua
local demo = require("hecate.demo")
demo.add(a, b) -> integer sum
demo.name() -> string name
demo.undocumented(value)
demo.wait(seconds, options?) -> number waited
```

## Parameters and return values

### Functions

| Name | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`add`](functions/add.md) | Adds two integers. |
| [`name`](functions/name.md) | Returns the name of the package. |
| [`undocumented`](functions/undocumented.md) | - |
| [`wait`](functions/wait.md) | Suspends the running coroutine for `seconds`, then returns how long it waited. |

### Classes and types

| Name | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`hecate.demo.Counter`](Counter.md) | Class | A counter that counts up by a fixed step. |
| [`hecate.demo.CounterError`](CounterError.md) | Error class | Raised by counters and by `demo.add` on misuse. |
| [`hecate.demo.CounterOptions`](CounterOptions.md) | Type | Options of a counter. |

### Fields

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | largest value a counter can reach |

## Errors raised

- [`hecate.demo.CounterError`](CounterError.md): Raised by counters and by `demo.add` on misuse.

## May suspend

These members may suspend the running coroutine (`---@async`); call them from a coroutine managed by the reactor.

- [`demo.wait`](functions/wait.md)
